$comment: INTERNAL analytics event catalog — human-readable source of truth. Machine mirror lives in @workspace/analytics-contract (PHASE1_EVENTS). Keep the two in sync. Events map only to REAL observed behavior; never fabricate. Analytics is INTERNAL ONLY — no consumer-facing analytics UI.

phase1.trigger: User accepts the analytics consent prompt
User finishes the onboarding wizard
App is launched or foregrounded
First app open of a calendar day
User begins a hydration ritual / protocol
User completes a hydration ritual / protocol
User logs a water / AForce intake
Daily hydration goal is reached
Engine recomputes the hydration score band
User follows the coach command / recommendation
The user earns their first Daily Win — the activation funnel's First Win milestone; emitted at most once, ever (persistent client flag)
An impact / explainability surface is shown
The orb transitions performance state
Acquisition QR / activation deep-link opened (printed on a can or in a marketing link); distinct from the in-app HydroScan receipt_scanned
A product barcode / receipt is scanned (HydroScan)
Server verifies a scanned receipt / product
A verified receipt is activated / credited
User answers an in-app survey / NPS question
User opens / acts on a reminder notification
User completes the daily morning Voice Check-In — counted at most once per local day (a same-day re-record does not re-emit)
User opens the Territory competition map — counted at most once per local day (re-entering the same day does not re-emit)

User takes a real, effectful engagement action inside Territory — inspecting a region or supporting a battle side; emitted per action. The stub Join / Challenge buttons are intentionally NOT instrumented (no real effect yet → would fabricate engagement)

Once per UTC day, the client records the member's display-only Performance Age™ estimate. Emits ONLY the privacy-safe years delta (performanceAge − actualAge, negative = younger) plus its lifecycle status — NEVER the actual age, birth year, biometrics, or sub-scores. A display-only health estimate, never a scoring input (Score-Protection)
A paid subscription becomes active — emitted CLIENT-side on confirmed checkout (sole emitter), carrying descriptive non-PII revenue metadata
The Day-7 subscription offer is shown to the user
